# `census_geocoder_lookups`

**Census geography lookup outcomes**

One explicit address or coordinate lookup with its complete original response and outcome.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Explicit single-record Census2020 address and coordinate lookups only. Local qualification covers the retained cohort; public delivery is separate. No national completeness, current district, ACS estimate, batch or ZIP-centroid claim. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `census_geocoder_lookups.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lookup_id` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 identity of the complete official request URL, including original input and fixed source versions. |
| `kind` | `VARCHAR` | Official single-record onelineaddress or coordinates search type. |
| `benchmark` | `VARCHAR` | Exact selected address locator benchmark, Public_AR_Census2020. |
| `vintage` | `VARCHAR` | Exact selected geography vintage, Census2020_Census2020; not acquisition time or an ACS estimate vintage. |
| `outcome` | `VARCHAR` | Matched, unmatched, ambiguous, refused or conversion_failed; only matched establishes a unique returned candidate. |
| `reason` | `VARCHAR` | Explicit source interpretation or refusal reason, otherwise null. |
| `request_url` | `VARCHAR` | Exact official GET request with original address or decimal coordinate strings and selected versions. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | UTC time when the complete response was captured. |
| `response_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | Digest of the complete retained original response bytes. |
| `source_release_logical_id` | `VARCHAR` | Logical identity of the admitted SpicyDocs lookup release. |
| `source_release_digest` | `VARCHAR` | Exact artifact digest of the admitted SpicyDocs lookup release. |
| `address` | `VARCHAR` | Original structure address string; null for a coordinate lookup. ZIP-only lookup is unsupported. |
| `input_x` | `VARCHAR` | Original longitude decimal string, in degrees; null for an address lookup. Never converted through binary float. |
| `input_y` | `VARCHAR` | Original latitude decimal string, in degrees; null for an address lookup. Never converted through binary float. |
| `candidate_count` | `INTEGER` | Returned supported candidate count. Refused and conversion-failed results carry no assignments. |
| `response_json` | `VARCHAR` | Complete original UTF-8 response, preserving every field, numeric spelling, null, empty string and empty array/object. |
